description:
Create a workout on Garmin Connect from a simple step list, and optionally put it on the calendar (scheduleDate). Use this instead of create-workout. The app shows the new workout's steps.

Example: 5x1km intervals on a Tuesday
{ "name": "5x1km @ 4:00", "sport": "running", "scheduleDate": "2026-10-06",
  "steps": [
    { "type": "warmup", "duration": { "seconds": 900 }, "target": { "hrZone": 2 } },
    { "repeat": 5, "steps": [
      { "type": "run", "duration": { "meters": 1000 }, "target": { "pace": { "fast": "3:55", "slow": "4:05" } } },
      { "type": "recovery", "duration": { "seconds": 90 } } ] },
    { "type": "cooldown", "duration": { "seconds": 600 }, "target": { "hrZone": 1 } } ] }

An easy run is a single { "type": "run", "duration": { "seconds": 2700 }, "target": { "hrZone": 2 } } step. Base targets on the user's own zones and recent paces (get-training-context).

scheduleDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: also put the workout on the user's Garmin calendar that day

steps.description: Steps in order. A step is { type, duration?, target? }; a repeat is { repeat: n, steps: [...] }.

description.description: Optional note shown on the watch

duration.description: How the step ends: { seconds: 600 }, { meters: 1000 }, or "lap.button" (until the user presses lap). Default "lap.button".

pace.description: Pace range per km, e.g. { fast: "4:30", slow: "4:50" }

fast.description: Pace per km as min:sec, e.g. "4:30"

slow.description: Pace per km as min:sec, e.g. "4:30"

target.description: Optional intensity target: an HR zone or a pace range. Omit for no target.

type.description: Step kind. "run" is a work interval or the main set; "recovery" is an easy jog between reps.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the steps

steps.description: Steps inside the repeat (e.g. a run and a recovery)
